assertion_results.text: Impact map or task descriptions explicitly flag at least 3 ambiguities from the feature description
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md has an 'Ambiguities flagged (clarification requested from Feature owner)' table with 9 numbered rows, e.g. #1 '"Search should be faster" / NFR "Should be fast enough" — no baseline, no target latency', #4 '"Results should be more relevant" — "relevant" undefined', #5 '"Add filters — some kind of filtering capability" — which fields... unspecified', #6 '"Better UI — make it look nicer" — no design, no frontend repo'. Each task file also has an '**Ambiguity flagged (pending clarification on TC-9002):**' paragraph.

assertion_results.text: Plan acknowledges that 'Better UI' (non-MVP) cannot be planned without design mockups or frontend repository and excludes it from scope
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md 'Excluded requirements' table: 'Better UI — "Make it look nicer" | No | No Figma design mockups were provided and no frontend repository is registered in the Repository Registry ... Cannot be decomposed into tasks until a design and target frontend repository are supplied.' Ambiguity #6: 'Cannot be planned at all | Excluded'. summary-comment.md: '**Excluded:** Better UI and frontend filter controls.' No UI task exists.

assertion_results.text: Tasks still follow the task-description-template.md format despite ambiguous requirements
assertion_results.evidence: All three task files (task-1-search-indexes.md, task-2-search-relevance-ranking.md, task-3-search-filters.md) use the template headings in template order: ## Repository, ## Target Branch, ## Description, ## Files to Modify, (## Files to Create / ## API Changes), ## Implementation Notes, ## Reuse Candidates, ## Acceptance Criteria (checkbox list), ## Test Requirements (checkbox list), ## Verification Commands, (## Documentation Updates in Task 3), ## Dependencies. Ambiguities and assumptions are placed inside the Description section, not as non-template sections.

assertion_results.text: Tasks document assumptions where they fill in missing details, labeled as assumptions pending clarification
assertion_results.evidence: Each task has a '**Assumptions pending clarification:**' block: Task 1 'ASSUMPTION A1'–'A4' (e.g. 'A3: no numeric latency target is defined; the acceptance bar is "measurably faster than the current baseline"'), Task 2 'ASSUMPTION B1'–'B4', Task 3 'ASSUMPTION C1'–'C4'. Acceptance criteria reference them, e.g. 'numeric target pending clarification (ASSUMPTION A3)', '(ASSUMPTION C3)'.

assertion_results.text: Every generated task description contains a Repository section with a single repository name (not multiple repos per task)
assertion_results.evidence: task-1, task-2, task-3 each begin with '## Repository' followed by the single line 'trustify-backend'.

assertion_results.text: Every generated task description contains Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, and Test Requirements sections as required by the handoff contract in task-description-template.md
assertion_results.evidence: All three task files contain '## Target Branch', '## Description', '## Acceptance Criteria' (7, 6, and 8 checkbox items respectively) and '## Test Requirements' (5, 5, and 9 checkbox items respectively).

assertion_results.text: File paths in Files to Modify and Files to Create reference paths from the repo-backend.md mock repository structure manifest, not invented paths
assertion_results.evidence: Files to Modify paths all appear in the repo-backend.md directory tree: migration/src/lib.rs, modules/search/src/service/mod.rs, modules/search/src/endpoints/mod.rs, entity/src/sbom.rs, entity/src/advisory.rs, entity/src/package.rs, common/src/db/query.rs, tests/api/search.rs. The one Files to Create entry, migration/src/m0002_search_indexes/mod.rs, is a new file following the manifest's existing migration/src/m0001_initial/mod.rs layout, which is expected for a file being created.

assertion_results.text: Implementation Notes in every task reference specific file paths and code patterns from the repository, not abstract or generic guidance
assertion_results.evidence: Task 1: 'Follow the existing migration module layout in migration/src/m0001_initial/mod.rs ... register it in migration/src/lib.rs', 'keep returning PaginatedResults<T> from common/src/model/paginated.rs', 'Result<T, AppError> (common/src/error.rs) with .context()'. Task 2: 'Use ts_rank_cd(<vector>, <tsquery>) in the ORDER BY clause of the query constructed in modules/search/src/service/mod.rs'. assertion_results.evidence: task-1, task-2, task-3 each contain '## Target Branch' followed by 'main'. impact-map.md: 'All tasks use Target Branch `main`.'

All three are 64 lowercase hex chars and appear again in the impact-map.md Task creation log Digest column.

assertion_results.text: Convention-aware enrichment validates file-type applicability per shared/convention-applicability-rules.md before including a convention — inapplicable conventions are excluded entirely (not listed with 'Not applicable' annotations), and applicable ones include a rationale in the prescribed format ('Applies: task modifies <file> matching the convention's <scope>'), not free-form prose
assertion_results.evidence: 14 'Per CONVENTIONS.md §...' lines across tasks (4/4/6), each followed by a prescribed-format rationale naming a file from that task's Files to Modify, e.g. 'Applies: task modifies modules/search/src/service/mod.rs matching the convention's `modules/*/src/{model,service,endpoints}` Rust module scope.', 'Applies: task modifies tests/api/search.rs matching the convention's `tests/api/*.rs` integration-test scope.', and in Task 3 'Applies: task modifies common/src/db/query.rs matching the convention's shared query-helper (`common/src/db/query.rs`) scope.' A grep for 'Not applicable', 'N/A', 'Caching' or 'Framework' in the task files finds nothing, so no convention is listed with an exclusion annotation.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks — evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When the Feature's priority is 'Undefined', the plan documents that priority inheritance is skipped (not propagated as null or 'Undefined')
assertion_results.evidence: The fixture's Feature priority is Normal. impact-map.md Task creation log: additional_fields applied to every created task (Tasks 1–3) includes '"priority": {"name": "Normal"}' and '- `priority`: Feature priority is `Normal` (set, not "Undefined") → inherited.'

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: The fixture Feature has Fix Versions: RHTPA 1.6.0, and CLAUDE.md sets fixVersion scope: both. impact-map.md additional_fields: '"fixVersions": [{"name": "RHTPA 1.6.0"}]' and '- `fixVersions`: Feature has `RHTPA 1.6.0` and CLAUDE.md `fixVersion scope: both` → inherited.'

assertion_results.text: A summary of inherited field propagation is produced — evidenced by a summary-comment.md file in the outputs directory, or a summary section in the impact map that includes the inherited priority and fixVersion values propagated to tasks, or states they were omitted and why
assertion_results.evidence: summary-comment.md exists and contains '**Inherited values:** priority Normal and fixVersion RHTPA 1.6.0 propagated to all tasks; label ai-generated-jira.'
